title: Bilingual Paralegal / Legal Assistant
description:
Company Description


CatalyzeX is a leading outsourcing partner specializing in delivering cost-effective and highly efficient labor solutions to businesses across various industries. We help companies scale their operations and achieve sustainable growth by providing top-tier talent and support.


Role Description


CatalyzeX is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Bilingual Paralegal (Spanish/English) to join our remote legal team. In this role, you will oversee the full lifecycle of case managementfrom intake through case closingserving as a central hub for document management and case organization. You will support attorneys and senior paralegals, ensuring all case materials are accurate, properly filed, and easily accessible, while helping maintain smooth workflows across the team.


Key Responsibilities


Case Intake & Opening

  • Process all new client intake information and documentation.
  • Create and organize new case files in legal case management systems.
  • Prepare engagement letters, conflict checks, intake forms, and other opening documents.
  • Coordinate with attorneys to ensure complete and accurate intake information.
  • Maintain case opening checklists to ensure consistency across all matters.

Case Management & Closing

  • Monitor ongoing cases and ensure case data is accurate and up-to-date.
  • Coordinate with attorneys to identify cases ready for closure.
  • Execute case closing procedures, including final billing, archiving documents, and updating case status.
  • Prepare case closing memoranda and coordinate return or destruction of client materials.

Document Management & Discovery

  • Serve as the central resource for locating and retrieving case documents and discovery materials.
  • Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems with consistent naming conventions.
  • Manage discovery materials, including indexing, tracking, and archiving.
  • Conduct periodic audits of case files to ensure compliance with filing standards.
  • Support attorneys and staff in document preparation, version control, and proper storage.

Administrative & Client Support

  • Provide general administrative support, including managing emails, phone calls, and calendars.
  • Assist with scheduling meetings and coordinating case-related communications.
  • Serve as a secondary point of contact for clients, providing updates and addressing inquiries.
  • Draft, file, and process legal documents and correspondence as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bilingual: Spanish and English proficiency required; must be based in Brazil or Latin America.
  • Strong American English communication skills (spoken and written).
  • Knowledge of legal procedures, case management, and document handling.
  • Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities with strong attention to detail.
  • Experience with legal case management software and cloud-based document systems.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Background in workers' compensation and personal injury law preferred.

Technical Requirements

Internet connection: High-speed internet required — minimum 20 Mbps or fiber connection

Computer / laptop: Employees must use a genuine, supported business laptop with built-in hardware security and full-disk encryption enabled. Unsupported, modified, bypass-installed, rooted, or jailbroken operating systems are not permitted.

  • Windows: Windows 11 (preferably Windows 11 Pro), 2021 model or newer, with TPM 2.0 enabled and BitLocker / Windows Device Encryption turned on
  • Mac: Apple MacBook / Mac, 2020 model or newer, preferably Apple Silicon M1 or newer, running a supported macOS version with FileVault enabled
  • Not permitted: Chromebooks (ChromeOS), tablets, and mobile devices are not supported and cannot be used for this role

RAM: Minimum 8 GB (16 GB preferred)

Noise-canceling headset

Power and internet backup required

Compensation: $7 per hour

Working Hours: Eastern or Pacific Time Zone


  • If you are highly organized, proactive, and eager to contribute to a growing legal team, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your application through our Careers Page ; only applications submitted via the career page form will be considered.

title: Senior Accounting Manager
description:
About MAVI


MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement.


The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.


Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Senior Accounting Manager to run the accounting operation for US-based client companies, working remotely from Brazil.


This is a senior management seat reporting to the Controller or Head of Accounting, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will manage the close, manage the accounting team, and hold first-line accountability for the accuracy of what the function produces before it reaches final review.


Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who fixes them and writes down how they now work.


You will work closely with the finance leadership, and directly with the operators whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.


Because your team sits outside the United States and the leadership you report to does not, the role calls for someone who runs their area without needing to be managed through it, escalates early rather than at review, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture across a time difference.


What You'll Own


The Close and Financial Reporting


  • The close. Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close end to end, with accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.
  • The financial statements. Prepare the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers your team produced.
  • Review. Provide first-line review over journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules, and send nothing upward you have not satisfied yourself on.
  • Revenue. Maintain revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules and the deferred revenue roll-forward, and prepare the judgements behind them for review.
  • Consolidation. Prepare multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that leadership and investors rely on, with root-cause commentary rather than a restatement of the variance.


Controls, Policy, and Audit


  • Policies and controls. Maintain and enforce accounting policies, internal controls, and approval workflows, and recommend changes where the current design no longer fits the company's stage.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow the function to run without depending on any single individual — including you.
  • Audit. Manage the annual audit or review day to day, including PBC preparation, direct response to auditor queries, and resolution of findings, escalating significant matters to the Controller.
  • External partners. Act as the day-to-day point of contact for US tax advisers and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding them to agreed standards and deadlines.


Accounting Operations and Team


  • The transactional cycle. Manage the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast.
  • The accounting team. Manage, review, mentor, and develop the accounting staff and bookkeepers reporting to you, and give the Controller an honest read on where each person stands.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP implementation and migration workstreams across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, and support platform selection.


What We're Looking For


  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct management of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience managing an audit or review, including direct response to external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of tightening accounting processes and controls that were not working, and documenting them so they stayed fixed
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, or Rippling
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • Contador Público (CPN) matriculado, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Experience through a first audit or an ERP implementation is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field


Who This Role Is For


This role is well suited to an accounting manager who wants to run an operation rather than administer one part of it.


You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion and show your work, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you. You are comfortable reviewing someone else's work and telling them plainly when it is not right, and equally comfortable being reviewed yourself.


Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.


Why Join Through MAVI


  • Run the close and manage the accounting team, with direct visibility to US finance leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain hands-on exposure to audits, ERP transformations, and control build-outs rather than observing them
  • Progress toward Controller, Head of Accounting, and Head of Finance opportunities through MAVI
  • Compensation in USD, paid reliably and on schedule


Work Arrangement


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will be placed with a single US client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts, and you will work directly with US-based leadership, auditors, and external partners.


Core availability sits within the Brazil business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
MAVI partners with high-growth US startups and SMEs, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly within their finance teams. This is not a traditional accounting role — you will carry the close for US clients and own real areas of their books in a fast-moving environment.


The Opportunity


As a Senior Accountant, you will run the day-to-day accounting for US clients, reporting to the client's Controller or finance lead.


This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will see the close from first accrual to final statement and own the parts that are usually spread across three people, with a US finance lead reviewing your work and available when a call needs to be made above your level. It suits someone who wants to carry a full set of books rather than process a queue within them, and who fixes a broken process rather than working around it each month.


What You Will Own


  • Carry end-to-end accounting (Record-to-Report) for US clients on a defined close calendar
  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles, with accountability for cycle time and the quality of what you deliver
  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepaids, fixed asset schedules, and month-end adjustments, with support attached
  • Prepare financial statements under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers you produced
  • Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and drive ageing items to resolution rather than reporting them
  • Maintain the supporting schedules behind the balances — prepaid amortisation, accrual detail, fixed asset registers, deferred revenue rollforwards
  • Handle and review AP, AR, payroll accounting, and cash reporting for accuracy and correct coding
  • Prepare variance analysis with root-cause commentary, in terms someone outside finance can act on
  • Act as a day-to-day US client contact, building strong working relationships with their finance team
  • Prepare PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries in your areas through to resolution
  • Operate within the client's accounting policies and controls, and flag where a control is followed in form but not in substance
  • Maintain the close checklists and SOPs that keep the close reproducible without depending on any single individual
  • Propose process improvements and automation that shorten the close


What We're Looking For


  • 5+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle end to end, rather than contribution to one part of it
  • Experience preparing full financial statements, including cash flow, for review
  • Strong reconciliation discipline and the judgment to know when a balance does not look right
  • Experience supporting an audit, including PBC preparation and direct auditor contact
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, Toast, or similar)
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • CA / CPA / ACCA (or equivalent), or active progress toward one, preferred
  • Excellent English communication, with the ability to explain an accounting outcome to a non-accountant
  • Ability to work with US time zone overlap


Why Join MAVI?


  • Carry a full close end to end for some of the most exciting US companies
  • Own real areas of a growing company's books rather than one corner of them
  • Gain exposure to audit, ERP work, and process design earlier than a comparable in-house role would offer
  • Clear progression to Accounting Team Lead, Accounting Manager, and Controller roles
  • Flexible remote work with global impact
  • Compensation in USD

Multi-entity accounting. Own consolidation across the group structure, including intercompany accounting, eliminations, and foreign currency translation.

title: FP&A Manager - Remote (Work from anywhere)
description:
About the job

Own SaaS Financial Planning. Drive US Business Strategy. Lead from Brazil.


MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting and finance professionals directly into their teams. In Mexico, we focus on building long-term partnerships — where professionals operate as a true extension of US finance teams, not just offshore support.


This is not traditional outsourcing. You will work directly with US founders, Controllers, and finance leaders in lean, fast-moving environments.


The Opportunity

We are hiring an FP&A Manager to lead financial planning and analysis for US-based SaaS clients with structured corporate finance operations. You will own the full planning cycle — from budget build to monthly reporting — while acting as a strategic finance partner to US CFOs and business leaders.


This role is designed for an experienced FP&A professional who understands SaaS unit economics, recurring revenue models, and how finance drives decision-making in high-growth tech companies.


What You Will Own

  • Lead annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting for US SaaS clients
  • Build and maintain financial models covering ARR, MRR, churn, and unit economics
  • Own monthly variance reporting with actionable business commentary for US leadership
  • Partner with US CFOs and senior leaders on strategic planning and scenario analysis
  • Develop KPI dashboards and financial performance frameworks
  • Analyze SaaS metrics including CAC, LTV, gross margin, and cohort retention
  • Support board-level reporting, investor presentations, and fundraising data
  • Drive improvements in financial planning processes and tooling


What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of FP&A experience in SaaS or corporate finance environments
  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, metrics, and recurring revenue dynamics
  • Experience working within or directly supporting corporate-structured SaaS companies
  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities
  • Proficiency with FP&A or BI tools (Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment, Tableau, or Excel)
  • Advanced English with strong executive communication skills
  • Ability to work consistently in US time zone overlap


Why Join MAVI?

  • Direct partnership with US CFOs and SaaS finance leadership teams
  • Own strategic FP&A for high-growth US tech businesses
  • Exposure to corporate-level finance in a fully remote setup
  • Competitive compensation and long-term client partnerships
  • Fast-track path into VP Finance and CFO-track roles

title: Head of Accounting
description:
About MAVI


MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.


We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed startups and SMEs building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.


The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence and satisfy its auditors.


Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting to own the accounting function across a portfolio of high-growth US client companies, working remotely from Brazil.


This is the senior accounting seat for each company you serve, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will be accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of each client for its audit.


Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who rebuilds them.


The portfolio structure is the defining feature of the role. You will hold several client companies at once, each at a different stage, on a different system, with a different close calendar. The work rewards someone who can carry that context without losing the detail, and who brings a consistent standard to every engagement rather than adapting to whatever each client has been doing.


You will work directly with founders, CEOs, and the leadership teams whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.


What You'll Own


The Close and Financial Reporting


  • The close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for each client, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.
  • The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of client leadership and auditors.
  • Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them.
  • Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that founders, leadership, and investors rely on.


Controls, Policy, and Audit


  • Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to each client's stage, and enforce them once established.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow each engagement to run without depending on any single individual.
  • Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out.
  • External partners. Manage external auditors, tax advisers, and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding each to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations

  • The transactional cycle. Own the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing across the portfolio, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast, and give leadership a reliable view of position and movement.


Team, Systems, and Standard


  • Client accounting teams. Review, mentor, and raise the standard of the accounting staff and bookkeepers working beneath you at each client.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation.
  • A consistent standard. Bring the same close discipline, documentation, and control expectations to every engagement, rather than inheriting each client's habits.


What We're Looking For


  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them
  • Demonstrated capacity to hold several companies or entities concurrently without loss of accuracy — prior experience in an outsourced accounting practice, a CPA firm, or a multi-entity group is directly relevant
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, Rippling, or FloQast
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • CRC-active Contador, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience serving venture-backed or PE-backed US companies, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field


Who This Role Is For


This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own the function outright, several times over, rather than administer one part of it once.


You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter and at the next client. You bring your own standard rather than adopting whatever you find. You are equally credible in a room with a founder, an auditor, and a junior bookkeeper.


Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.


Why Join Through MAVI


  • Own entire accounting functions, end to end, with direct exposure to US founders and senior leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of growing companies rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain breadth across several businesses, stages, and systems in a single seat
  • Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI
  • Work remotely from Brazil in near-full overlap with the US business day


Work Arrangement


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will serve several US client companies concurrently and will work directly with their founders, leadership teams, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazilian business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

  • Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them.
  • Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that founders, leadership, and investors rely on.


Controls, Policy, and Audit


  • Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to each client's stage, and enforce them once established.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow each engagement to run without depending on any single individual.
  • Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out.
  • External partners. Manage external auditors, tax advisers, and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding each to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations

  • The transactional cycle. Own the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing across the portfolio, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast, and give leadership a reliable view of position and movement.


Team, Systems, and Standard


  • Client accounting teams. Review, mentor, and raise the standard of the accounting staff and bookkeepers working beneath you at each client.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation.
  • A consistent standard. Bring the same close discipline, documentation, and control expectations to every engagement, rather than inheriting each client's habits.


What We're Looking For


  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them
  • Demonstrated capacity to hold several companies or entities concurrently without loss of accuracy — prior experience in an outsourced accounting practice, a CPA firm, or a multi-entity group is directly relevant
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, Rippling, or FloQast
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • CRC-active Contador, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience serving venture-backed or PE-backed US companies, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field


Who This Role Is For


This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own the function outright, several times over, rather than administer one part of it once.


You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter and at the next client. You bring your own standard rather than adopting whatever you find. You are equally credible in a room with a founder, an auditor, and a junior bookkeeper.


Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.


Why Join Through MAVI


  • Own entire accounting functions, end to end, with direct exposure to US founders and senior leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of growing companies rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain breadth across several businesses, stages, and systems in a single seat
  • Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI
  • Work remotely from Brazil in near-full overlap with the US business day


Work Arrangement


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will serve several US client companies concurrently and will work directly with their founders, leadership teams, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazilian business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

title: Financial Planning Manager
description:
Turn recurring reporting into a decision system.

Own management reporting, KPI dashboards, and forward-looking analysis for US leadership teams.

This is not a task-execution role. You will be expected to own outcomes, exercise judgment, improve how the work gets done, and communicate directly with senior stakeholders.


About MAVI

MAVI is an invite-only network connecting high-performing finance and accounting professionals with fast-growing US companies. Members are assessed for technical capability, communication, ownership, and leadership potential. Through MAVI, you work directly with finance leaders, own meaningful outcomes, and build a track record that can lead to increasingly senior opportunities.


What you'll own

  • Build and maintain executive, board, and investor reporting packages.
  • Develop KPI dashboards that connect operating metrics with financial outcomes.
  • Produce variance analysis and forward-looking commentary for monthly business reviews.
  • Partner with data, accounting, and functional teams to improve source-data quality.
  • Automate recurring reporting and reduce manual spreadsheet work.
  • Translate trends into concise actions, risks, and opportunities.


What makes you a fit

  • 6+ years in FP&A, financial analysis, business intelligence, or management reporting.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets capability; Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools are valuable.
  • Experience building reporting for executives, boards, or investors.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, KPIs, and variance analysis.
  • Able to distinguish meaningful signals from reporting noise.
  • Excellent written communication and comfort working with US stakeholders.


The seniority bar

  • You independently structure ambiguous business questions and turn them into decision-ready financial analysis.
  • You challenge assumptions constructively and can defend your recommendation with executives and non-finance leaders.
  • You build models and reporting frameworks that others can use—not one-off analyses that depend entirely on you.
  • You understand the business implication behind the numbers and communicate a clear point of view.


What success looks like

  • Leadership receives consistent, trusted reporting with less manual effort.
  • KPI and financial narratives clearly identify what changed and what to do next.
  • Data-quality issues are surfaced and resolved at the source.


Why join now

Deliver strongly in this scope and build toward FP&A Manager or Finance Business Partner opportunities across the MAVI network. Compensation is USD-denominated and aligned with experience, scope, and location. Working hours are designed around local schedules with reasonable, clearly defined overlap for US stakeholders.

title: Product Designer Mobile & Web | Remote
description:
Ambanga Technologies is a small, fast-moving technology company building mobile and web products. Most of our team is based in Brazil, with a few of us internationally, and we work very closely across design, product and development.

We’re expanding our design team and looking for a strong Product Designer to join us.

We’re looking for someone with great attention to detail, strong product thinking and a real startup attitude . You need to be someone who looks beyond the screen you’ve been asked to design. Someone who asks questions, spots things others might miss and thinks about how the whole experience works for the user.


The role


You’ll work across our products, taking ownership of design work from early ideas through to implementation. You’ll work closely with Product, developers, QA and the wider team, and will need to be comfortable adapting as priorities change.

The role will include:

  • Product discovery and exploring new ideas
  • Turning early ideas into clear user journeys
  • Researching competitors and how other products solve similar problems
  • Wireframes, user flows and high-fidelity designs
  • Creating prototypes for user interviews and testing
  • Designing across iOS, Android and web
  • Working with and improving our design systems
  • Working closely with developers throughout implementation
  • Improving designs based on feedback and what we learn from real users
  • Occasionally helping with other design or creative work across the business

There’s a lot going on and plenty to learn, so no two days are exactly the same.


What matters to us


Attention to detail is a big one.

We need someone who naturally spots things that don’t quite make sense — a missing state, an unclear action, an inconsistency or something in a journey that could confuse the user.

We also want someone who can work independently. You won’t always be given a perfectly written brief. Sometimes you’ll get an idea or a problem and need to research it, ask the right questions and come back with possible solutions.

You should be curious and proactive. Look at what other products are doing, bring new ideas to the team and be willing to challenge something if you think there’s a better way of doing it.

We’re a very collaborative team, so you need to be comfortable sharing your work, receiving feedback and changing direction when needed. We move quickly and priorities can change, so being flexible is important. Sometimes something else becomes more important and we all need to jump in and help.

We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership of their work . The job doesn’t finish when a design is handed over to development. We expect our designers to look at what has actually been built, use it and help make sure the final experience is right.


What we're looking for


  • Relevant experience as a Product / UX/UI Designer
  • A strong portfolio showing real digital products you’ve worked on
  • Experience designing for mobile and web
  • Good understanding of iOS and Android UX patterns
  • Experience with discovery, user flows and prototyping
  • Experience creating prototypes for interviews and user testing
  • Experience working with design systems
  • Comfortable working closely with developers
  • Able to work independently and take ownership of a piece of work
  • Very strong attention to detail
  • Curious, proactive and happy to bring ideas to the table
  • Comfortable working in a startup where things can move quickly
  • Fluent English , written and spoken


The setup


  • Remote
  • Contractor / PJ
  • Monday to Friday
  • The team starts at 7:30am Brazil time , so you need to be available for our daily meetings and team discussions
  • Looking for someone who can start as soon as possible


Please include a link to your Product Design portfolio in your CV.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small design challenge and then talk us through how they approached it and why they made the decisions they did.

title: Business English Teacher
description:
Help Brazilian Executives Find Their Voice in English


You know that moment when a student finally nails a presentation they were terrified of? Or closes a deal they almost lost to a language barrier? That's what we do at YouAble - and we're looking for teachers who live for those moments.


We teach Business English 1:1 to executives across Brazil. No scripts. No generic curricula. Each student gets a learning path built around their actual job, their actual challenges, their actual goals.


The role:

  • Individual classes (30 or 60 min), ~25 hours per week
  • Track each student's progress and adapt constantly
  • Work closely with our coordination team on methodology


The deal:

  • R$ 60/hour (contractor)
  • 100% remote
  • Flexible schedule within morning (7AM-1PM) and evening (5PM-10PM) windows, Brasília time
  • Real growth opportunity as the company scales


You're a fit if:

  • Your English is fluent or native
  • You've worked in a corporate environment

You know that moment when a student finally nails a presentation they were terrified of? Or closes a deal they almost lost to a language barrier? That's what we do at YouAble - and we're looking for teachers who live for those moments.


We teach Business English 1:1 to executives across Brazil. No scripts. No generic curricula. Each student gets a learning path built around their actual job, their actual challenges, their actual goals.


The role:

  • Individual classes (30 or 60 min), ~25 hours per week
  • Track each student's progress and adapt constantly
  • Work closely with our coordination team on methodology


The deal:

  • R$ 60/hour (contractor)
  • 100% remote
  • Flexible schedule within morning (7AM-1PM) and evening (5PM-10PM) windows, Brasília time
  • Real growth opportunity as the company scales


You're a fit if:

  • Your English is fluent or native
  • You've worked in a corporate environment

title: AI Engineer
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer

Location: LATAM – Remote

Mode: Contract

Job Description:

Builds the agents, models, and integrations on the platform's templates — the hands that turn use cases into production systems.


What they'll do

  • Build and ship LLM-powered agents and workflows on the paved path (templates, pipeline, guardrails)
  • Write and run evals for everything built; no system ships without passing its suite
  • Integrate with GoodRx systems and data sources; instrument for cost and quality telemetry
  • Pair with business users to iterate quickly inside bounded scopes


Must have

  • 8+ years software engineering; 2.5+ building LLM applications in production (agents, RAG, tool use)
  • Strong Python/TypeScript; API craftsmanship; prompt and context engineering that survives contact with users
  • Can write LLM evals as part of building — non-negotiable
  • Ships fast without skipping guardrails


Nice to have

  • Retrieval/IR depth (for assistant-facing work); healthcare data handling; cost-optimization experience

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
Senior Marketing Designer

Shoplift · Remote · August 2026



About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind — making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15–30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants, with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores — from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of fewer than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners — handpicked by Shopify themselves, and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.

We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.

We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.



The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.

Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS. Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.

And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.



This is a range role, not a specialty role

You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.

That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.



How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure

This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.

We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.

Just as important: we want someone with the judgment to know where AI makes work worse, and the conviction to not use it there. Taste doesn't get outsourced to a model. If your AI answer is a list of tool names, this isn't the right role for you.

You'll have real latitude to invent this. Nobody here is going to hand you a workflow.



What You'll Do

Marketing creative & campaign assets

  • Design static ad systems for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets — ebooks, guides, one-pagers — that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, with Shoplift vs. without) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency

Brand & sales materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product marketing visualization

  • Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself
  • Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web
  • Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets

You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



What success looks like

By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.

By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.



You're a Great Fit If…

Must-haves

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems
  • Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it
  • Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area
  • You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team
  • A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves

  • Motion design or animation
  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention



How we work, and who does well here

High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.

Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. \"It looked great\" is not a result.

Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.



What We Offer

  • Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually
  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product



How to Apply

Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:

You'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked.
  • How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?

We're excited to meet you.

Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.

And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.



This is a range role, not a specialty role

You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.

That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.



How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure

This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.

We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.

Just as important: we want someone with the judgment to know where AI makes work worse, and the conviction to not use it there. Taste doesn't get outsourced to a model. If your AI answer is a list of tool names, this isn't the right role for you.

You'll have real latitude to invent this. Nobody here is going to hand you a workflow.



What You'll Do

Marketing creative & campaign assets

  • Design static ad systems for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets — ebooks, guides, one-pagers — that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, with Shoplift vs. without) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency

Brand & sales materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product marketing visualization

  • Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself
  • Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web
  • Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets

You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



What success looks like

By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.

By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.



You're a Great Fit If…

Must-haves

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems
  • Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it
  • Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area
  • You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team
  • A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves

  • Motion design or animation
  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention



How we work, and who does well here

High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.

Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. \"It looked great\" is not a result.

Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.



What We Offer

  • Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually
  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product



How to Apply

Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:

You'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked.
  • How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?

We're excited to meet you.

title: Client Lead Staffing (Bilingual)
description:
Position Overview


We are seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven Client Recruiting Lead to spearhead client acquisition, relationship management, and recruitment delivery across Brazil. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for winning new business, presenting recruitment solutions, managing client engagements, and ensuring successful execution of recruitment projects.

The ideal candidate combines strong business development skills with hands-on recruiting expertise. They are comfortable opening doors, closing new clients, leading client presentations, managing search delivery teams, and personally contributing to candidate sourcing and recruitment efforts when needed.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a growth environment, enjoys building client partnerships, and is willing to roll up their sleeves to ensure exceptional recruitment outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


Business Development & Client Growth


  • Identify, develop, and close new client relationships across Brazil.
  • Build a strong pipeline of prospective clients through networking, referrals, market mapping, and outbound business development activities.
  • Present recruitment solutions, service offerings, and engagement models to prospective clients.
  • Negotiate commercial terms and secure signed recruitment engagements.
  • Develop strategic account plans to grow and expand client relationships.
  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell additional recruitment, talent advisory, RPO, executive search, or consulting services.


Client Relationship Management


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for key client accounts.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with hiring managers, HR leaders, and executive stakeholders.
  • Conduct intake meetings to understand hiring needs, organizational structures, and business objectives.
  • Provide market intelligence, talent insights, and hiring recommendations.
  • Maintain high levels of client satisfaction and retention.


Recruitment Delivery Leadership


  • Oversee the end-to-end recruitment process across assigned client engagements.
  • Ensure delivery teams meet quality, timeline, and hiring objectives.
  • Manage recruitment workflows, candidate pipelines, and client communications.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and ensure successful project outcomes.
  • Lead recruitment strategy discussions and hiring progress reviews with clients.


Hands-On Recruitment


  • Personally manage and deliver key searches when required.
  • Conduct candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, and assessment activities.
  • Support recruiters on difficult or high-priority assignments.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines within targeted industries and functions.
  • Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.


Market & Leadership Contributions


  • Stay informed on labor market trends, compensation benchmarks, and hiring practices within Brazil.
  • Provide thought leadership and recruitment expertise both internally and externally.
  • Support process improvement initiatives and best practices across recruitment operations.
  • Mentor and develop recruiting team members as the business grows.


Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of recruitment, executive search, RPO, staffing, or talent acquisition experience.
  • Demonstrated success in business development and client acquisition.
  • Experience leading recruitment engagements and managing client relationships.
  • Proven ability to close recruitment projects and generate new business revenue.
  • Strong understanding of full-cycle recruitment and talent acquisition best practices.
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and professional proficiency in English.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience within a recruitment agency, executive search firm, or RPO environment.
  • Existing network of corporate HR and business leaders in Brazil.
  • Experience scaling client accounts and cross-selling additional service offerings.
  • Leadership experience managing recruiters or recruitment delivery teams.
  • Knowledge of recruiting across multiple industries and functional disciplines.


Success Measures


  • New client acquisition and revenue generation.
  • Client retention and account growth.
  • Cross-selling and expansion of existing accounts.
  • Successful delivery of recruitment engagements.
  • Time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, and client satisfaction metrics.
  • Growth of the Brazil business and market presence.

title: Instrutor de Treinamento (Automotivo) - Freelancer
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em Vendas no segmento automotivo para atuar no desenvolvimento de conteúdos e na condução de treinamentos voltados às operações comerciais da rede de concessionárias, garantindo profundidade técnica, aplicação prática e impacto nos resultados de vendas.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver conteúdos técnicos, comerciais e comportamentais para programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento da área de Vendas.
  • Ministrar treinamentos presenciais e virtuais para equipes comerciais, lideranças e profissionais que atuam na jornada de vendas da concessionária.
  • Traduzir conceitos estratégicos e processos comerciais em conteúdos claros, objetivos e aplicáveis à realidade do negócio.
  • Desenvolver treinamentos voltados para prospecção, qualificação de clientes, gestão de leads, negociação, técnicas de vendas, conversão e fidelização.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de competências de liderança comercial, gestão de equipes e melhoria contínua dos indicadores de performance.
  • Acompanhar tendências, processos e melhores práticas do mercado automotivo e de vendas consultivas, garantindo a atualização contínua dos conteúdos de treinamento.
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos programas de aprendizagem, promovendo engajamento, qualidade e impacto nos resultados comerciais.
  • Atuar como parceiro consultivo junto às áreas de negócio, identificando necessidades de treinamento, oportunidades de desenvolvimento e iniciativas para aumento de performance comercial.
  • Desenvolver conteúdos alinhados às necessidades específicas da rede de concessionárias, garantindo aplicabilidade prática às rotinas e desafios da operação de vendas.
  • Incorporar conceitos e boas práticas de experiência do cliente nos programas de treinamento, fortalecendo o relacionamento e a jornada comercial.
  • Facilitar workshops, dinâmicas e discussões estruturadas que promovam troca de experiências, fortalecimento das competências comerciais e desenvolvimento de lideranças.
  • Demonstrar profundo entendimento dos processos de vendas automotivas, utilizando linguagem adequada ao público-alvo e abordando desafios, oportunidades e melhores práticas do segmento.
  • Conectar pessoas, processos, indicadores e estratégias comerciais, proporcionando uma experiência de aprendizagem relevante e alinhada aos objetivos da rede de concessionárias.


Requisitos

  • Graduação completa.
  • Sólido conhecimento em processos, indicadores e estratégias de vendas no segmento automotivo.
  • Experiência em concessionárias automotivas, especialmente nas áreas de Vendas, Gestão Comercial e Atendimento ao Cliente.
  • Conhecimento sobre gestão de leads, funil de vendas, negociação, relacionamento com clientes e performance comercial.
  • Vivência na condução de treinamentos e desenvolvimento de conteúdo para equipes comerciais e lideranças.
  • Habilidade para facilitar treinamentos e promover aprendizagem de forma prática, dinâmica e engajadora.
  • Capacidade de conectar aspectos técnicos, comerciais e comportamentais para gerar impacto nos resultados de vendas.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com treinamento corporativo no segmento automotivo.
  • Vivência em programas de desenvolvimento de lideranças comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de aprendizagem.
  • Experiência na utilização de plataformas de aprendizagem e ferramentas digitais de treinamento.
  • Certificações ou formações relacionadas a vendas consultivas, negociação ou liderança comercial.


Competências Comportamentais

  • Comunicação e influência.
  • Facilidade para relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Protagonismo e senso de dono.
  • Capacidade de engajar diferentes públicos.
  • Orientação para resultados.
  • Pensamento analítico e visão de negócio.
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe.
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade.
  • Mentalidade de crescimento (Growth Mindset).


Perfil Desejado

Profissional apaixonado pelo desenvolvimento de pessoas e pela evolução dos resultados de vendas, com forte visão comercial e conhecimento do mercado automotivo. Deve ser capaz de atuar como facilitador, consultor e instrutor, compreendendo profundamente a realidade das concessionárias e transformando desafios comerciais em oportunidades de aprendizagem. Espera-se que contribua para o fortalecimento das competências da força de vendas, aumento da performance comercial, melhoria da experiência do cliente e crescimento sustentável dos resultados da rede de concessionárias.

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Oportunidade para um(a) professora(a) de alemão, que busca trabalhar de forma remota e flexível, se desprendendo do método tradicional de ensino e impactando positivamente na vida de centenas de alunos e alunas.


Buscamos um profissional paciente, responsável e proativo. Não é necessário ter experiência.


Tipo de contratação: PJ;

Nível de proficiência: B2 ou acima.

Horário: a combinar.

Salário: a combinar.

Local: Remoto.


Atividades principais:

• Aulas de Conversação e Plantões de Dúvidas, conforme metodologia do curso.


Requisitos Necessários:

• Proficiência de Nível B2 ou acima.

• Experiência intermediária com pacote Office.

• Agilidade;

• Boa comunicação.

• Paciência;


Habilidades Diferenciais (mas não obrigatórias):

• Graduado(a) ou graduando(a) em Letras.

• Experiência com viagens/intercâmbio para países falantes de alemão;

• Experiência com produção de conteúdo para redes sociais.


Quem Somos:

A GC Ensino é uma empresa especializada em lançamentos digitais de infoprodutos, idealizadora da escola de alemão \"Missão Alemão\" e do curso \"Programa Deutsch Pro\".


Isso significa que transformamos vidas através do conhecimento!


Nosso papel é promover a educação e impactar positivamente milhares de pessoas ao redor do mundo, através do idioma alemão. E tudo isso utilizando uma ferramenta que mudou a forma com que nós, seres humanos, nos comunicamos: a internet!


  • Gostou do nosso propósito e está interessado(a) em fazer parte do nosso time? Faça sua aplicação.

title: Project Management Officer
description:
Job Title: PMO Analyst

Location: Brazil – Remote

Employment Type: Contract (CST or EST Time Zone)


Job Summary

We are seeking a PMO Analyst with 3–6 years of experience supporting program and project management in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will maintain integrated project plans, manage RAID logs, build executive dashboards, and prepare steering committee materials. Experience with Excel and project management tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, or MS Project is required. Life sciences industry experience is a strong advantage.

Required Skills

  • 3–6 years of PMO, project coordination, or program analytics experience
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel
  • Experience with Smartsheet, Jira, MS Project, or similar PM tools
  • Dashboard creation and project reporting
  • RAID log management and project planning
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills
  • Ability to support weekly reporting cycles with high accuracy

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in the Life Sciences or Healthcare domain
  • Process standardization and continuous improvement
  • User adoption and localization support for Mexico operations

title: Freelancer  Gestão de Projetos Jr.
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Freelancer para Gestão de Projetos Jr. com foco em entregas de tecnologia e produtos digitais.


Atribuições:


● Auxiliar no planejamento e priorização do backlog através de reuniões semanais

com equipe interna, estimando esforço e, por fim, o fechamento da sprint semanal.

Em seguida, alinhamento da mesma com o cliente.

● Receber e entender o briefing do cliente e, a partir disso, verificar a necessidade do

debriefing. Disseminar o briefing recebido para as demais áreas, através de reunião

de kickoff com toda a equipe necessária.

● Atualizar, controlar e mapear as atividades do time, reportando sempre a gestão as

atividades e entregas da semana.

● Garantir que os processos sejam respeitados, e as plataformas (internas e do

cliente) estejam sempre atualizadas e fazer com que os prazos pré acordados sejam

atendidos.

● Garantir que as entregas estejam de acordo com o briefing, fazendo a validação

interna antes de dividir com o cliente.

● Manter boa comunicação e transparência com cliente e áreas internas;

● Participar ativamente das atividades, discussões e cerimônias de gestão (daily,

planning, review).

● Organizar e alinhar a rede e seus materiais, acompanhando sempre se as entregas

estão sendo colocadas nessa plataforma.


Requisitos


● Familiaridade com ferramentas de metodologia ágil;

● Conhecimentos em keynote, excel e power point;

● Aptidão com ambiente digital e tecnologias;

● Aptidão para resolução de problemas;

● Excelente habilidade de comunicação.



Contrato como Pessoa Jurídica

Duração de 90 dias

Remoto

description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Freelancer para Gestão de Projetos Jr. com foco em entregas de tecnologia e produtos digitais.


Atribuições:


● Auxiliar no planejamento e priorização do backlog através de reuniões semanais

com equipe interna, estimando esforço e, por fim, o fechamento da sprint semanal.

Em seguida, alinhamento da mesma com o cliente.

● Receber e entender o briefing do cliente e, a partir disso, verificar a necessidade do

debriefing. Disseminar o briefing recebido para as demais áreas, através de reunião

de kickoff com toda a equipe necessária.

● Atualizar, controlar e mapear as atividades do time, reportando sempre a gestão as

atividades e entregas da semana.

● Garantir que os processos sejam respeitados, e as plataformas (internas e do

cliente) estejam sempre atualizadas e fazer com que os prazos pré acordados sejam

atendidos.

● Garantir que as entregas estejam de acordo com o briefing, fazendo a validação

interna antes de dividir com o cliente.

● Manter boa comunicação e transparência com cliente e áreas internas;

● Participar ativamente das atividades, discussões e cerimônias de gestão (daily,

planning, review).

● Organizar e alinhar a rede e seus materiais, acompanhando sempre se as entregas

estão sendo colocadas nessa plataforma.


Requisitos


● Familiaridade com ferramentas de metodologia ágil;

● Conhecimentos em keynote, excel e power point;

● Aptidão com ambiente digital e tecnologias;

● Aptidão para resolução de problemas;

● Excelente habilidade de comunicação.



Contrato como Pessoa Jurídica

Duração de 90 dias

title: Digital Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

We’re looking for a process-oriented, analytical, and detail-oriented Digital Operations Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will work closely with the Planning, Analytics and Process Optimization Associate Director to provide analytical support across the company. You will also support digital operations. 


Role Responsibilities

Analytics :

  • Analyze e-commerce performance, including orders, conversion rates, revenue, customer behavior, and product performance 
  • Monitor and analyze digital operations across e-commerce, marketing, customer experience, and internal platforms
  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, Finance, and Leadership to track KPIs and solve operational issues
  • Run cost benefit analysis of various workstreams
  • Analyze project and campaign performance
  • Support the Planning, Analytics and Process Optimization Associate Director in various ad-hoc analyses to support business decisions and strategic projects


Digital and E-commerce Operations:

  • Manage the sort of products on our website.
  • Project management of workstreams that are interdepartmental in nature
  • Manage analytics related audits of digital operations


Qualifications:

  • Proficiency in both written and spoken English
  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics or related field 
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
  • Attention to detail and a data-driven approach to problem-solving.
  • Basic to intermediate understanding of E-commerce platforms and website maintenance.
  • Deep experience working with Google Sheets or Excel is required.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment:

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Better Together: We believe in contributing creatively and openly, helping others, and championing our people and customers.
  • Owner’s Mindset: We work diligently, seek out problems, take a bias for action, and own our mistakes.
  • Quality and Craftsmanship: We take pride in what we do and value quality in our work and products. 
  • Process Orientation: We show our work, think ahead, and seek continuous improvement. 
  • Moving Quickly: We are proactive people who take initiative and get things done in a timely manner.
  • Doing the Right Thing: We act with integrity and own our actions.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

title: (Sr.) Director, Regulatory Affairs (Brazil)
description:
We are partnered with a company that is seeking an experienced (Sr.) Director of Regulatory Affairs to lead the development and execution of global regulatory strategies supporting the clinical development and commercialization of innovative therapies. This individual will play a key role in regulatory planning, submission strategy, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful interactions with global health authorities.


Responsibilites:

  • Develop and execute global regulatory strategies to support product development, clinical trials, and marketing approvals.
  • Provide regulatory guidance to cross-functional teams and ensure alignment with overall development and business objectives.
  • Lead the planning, preparation, authoring, and review of regulatory submissions to global health authorities, including the FDA, EMA, and other international agencies.
  • Support regulatory submissions across the product lifecycle, including INDs, CTAs, NDAs, BLAs, and MAAs.
  • Ensure regulatory documentation is accurate, complete, compliant with global regulatory requirements, and delivered within established timelines.
  • Monitor regulatory deliverables, identify potential risks, and proactively implement mitigation strategies to support submission timelines.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, external vendors, and regulatory operations to support submission planning, publishing, and document management activities.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of regulatory processes, document standards, submission workflows, and regulatory systems.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • Master’s Degree in life sciences discipline preferred
  • 7+ years experience in drug development and regulatory affairs
  • Must have experience with regulatory submission documents
